title: A gap in the portfolio
prompt: Your portfolio is complete except for one item: no architecture review with a Glean technical resource has happened. What do you do?

options.text: Submit now; reviewers can do the review during the audit.
options.feedback: The review is a requirement, not an audit step to defer.

options.text: Replace it with a self-review against the rubric.
options.feedback: Self-review is good preparation, but it does not replace the required review.

options.text: Schedule the architecture review, then submit.
options.feedback: Right. The competency requires a custom connector architecture review with a Glean technical resource.

takeaway: Close every requirement before you submit.
